comments.author: @legionnaire_xXx
comments.text: Honestly came across this channel yesterday and absolutely LOVE it! Destined to become very, very big.. one tip: don't make the videos too long just yet. Focus on what has worked and first build up that base with popular topics before going too long or too niche.. Make something Canada related, Ukraine, Iran or Israel.. you need some spice and actuality and those countries are HOT right now. Keep going❤

replies.author: @BecauseGeography
replies.text:
Thanks so much for your comment, amazing to hear comments like this and absolutely huge motivation to continue with what I'm doing 🙏
Love the tip and I've been wondering that exact point you raise. I love the in-depth and long videos because I like to feel like I've covered the topic with sufficient depth. However, for growth while my channel is still relatively small, the strategy is probably to steer toward shorter videos. I've written the 3 which are to come, which are longer, but I think I may listen to your advice and try shorter ones from then on and see how they fare. And good point about the in-demand nations..... super appreciative of the support 🙏🫡

comments.author: @BecauseGeography
comments.text:
The British Empire is always something that has fascinated me, I guess being British and all. But this video isn't on the moral argument whether the empire was good or bad. It's looking at the myriad of reasons why the British were able to build the biggest empire the world has ever seen. 

Would love to know everyone's thoughts on this. I always try my best to get all my info as accurate as possible but if you think I've got anything wrong or not quite hit the mark, do let me know. 

I do try to read as many comments as I can - would love to hear everyone thoughts? 👇

Much love everyone! 😃
